summary: Sable Offshore Corp. filed an 8-K reporting an amendment to its Senior Secured Term Loan with Exxon Mobil, extending the maturity date to the earlier of July 24, 2026 or acceleration upon default. A $30 million amendment fee is payable. The amendment includes a limited waiver of PSA financial security obligations until December 22, 2028. This is a routine debt modification, not a special situation. No acquisition, divestiture, or similar event is involved. The registrant is the issuer. What to watch: near-term debt maturity risk and potential refinancing.
